items.quote: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.
items.contrast: The reason is the certainty of the man of God’s message, not merely that the speaker has just buried him.
items.reason: The causal word “For” directly connects the burial request to the certainty that the Lord’s message will come true, so the key is fully supported. However, “the man” is an avoidably vague reference because the passage also mentions “the man of God”; the stem should identify the speaker more clearly. Understanding the question requires distinguishing the stated reason from the preceding burial action.
